name: KeeWeb
description: Custom Electron updater verifies RSA-SHA256 vs an embedded pubkey before executing; auto off by default.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The original A tier is supported by concrete application-side enforcement: the platform asset is accompanied by a detached signature, the asset bytes are checked with RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5/SHA-256, and verification uses bundled public-key resources before the update is marked ready. The autoUpdate default is install, so the original auto-off detail is false and must be corrected. The unsigned version manifest and the fact that the later installer launches a cached asset limit the broader security conclusion, but they do not contradict the observed payload signature control or warrant changing the tier.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot at commit ad7891de92cf666400a6b4c859eeb731b0f68761, not the original study checkout; historical release behavior may differ.

This review establishes application-side signature verification and the default setting; release administration, key custody, TLS behavior outside the reviewed code, and platform installer internals are not established.

original_evidence.text: | KeeWeb | github.com/keeweb/keeweb | Electron (custom updater, not electron-updater) | Y | user-configurable: `AppSettingsModel.autoUpdate` unset by default → periodic checks only scheduled when a user turns on auto-update (`'notify'` or `'install'`); manual "check for updates" always available; updater disabled entirely on Linux | Y | HTTPS: `Links.UpdateJson = https://app.keeweb.info/update.json` (unsigned version manifest) + `Links.UpdateBasePath = https://github.com/keeweb/keeweb/releases/download/v{ver}/` for the installer asset and a separate `Verify.sign.sha256` file; TLS validation ENFORCED (no `rejectUnauthorized`/`NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED`/`checkServerIdentity` bypass found in app/scripts) | N (update.json is a plain unsigned JSON version/date manifest) | signature (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, SHA-256) — the downloaded installer's SHA-256 digest is signed and verified via WebCrypto `subtle.verify` against an embedded RSA public key before install | embedded in app bundle: `app/scripts/public-key.pem` and `public-key-new.pem` (two allowed keys, first-match verification) | app/scripts/comp/app/updater.js:15-21 (enabled = `Launcher?.updaterEnabled()`, mac/win only per launcher-electron.js:205-207 `process.platform !== 'linux'`), :26-32 (`getAutoUpdateType` reads `AppSettingsModel.autoUpdate`, no repo-wide default found → falsy by default), :99-156 (`check()` GETs `Links.UpdateJson` over HTTPS, unsigned), :171-243 (`update()` downloads installer asset then a `Verify.sign.sha256` signature file), :245-268 (`verifySignature()` hex-decodes signature, calls `SignatureVerifier.verify`), app/scripts/util/data/signature-verifier.js:1-4,25-40,68-76 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5/SHA-256 verify against `public-key.pem`/`public-key-new.pem`), app/scripts/const/links.js:10,13 (URLs), desktop/scripts/update-installer.js:6-63 (`installUpdate` spawns the downloaded `.exe`/mounts the `.dmg` installer directly via `spawn`/`spawnSync`, executing the downloaded file) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: user-configurable: `AppSettingsModel.autoUpdate` unset by default → periodic checks only scheduled when a user turns on auto-update (`'notify'` or `'install'`); manual "check for updates" always available; updater disabled entirely on Linux

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS: `Links.UpdateJson = https://app.keeweb.info/update.json` (unsigned version manifest) + `Links.UpdateBasePath = https://github.com/keeweb/keeweb/releases/download/v{ver}/` for the installer asset and a separate `Verify.sign.sha256` file; TLS validation ENFORCED (no `rejectUnauthorized`/`NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED`/`checkServerIdentity` bypass found in app/scripts)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N (update.json is a plain unsigned JSON version/date manifest)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: signature (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, SHA-256) — the downloaded installer's SHA-256 digest is signed and verified via WebCrypto `subtle.verify` against an embedded RSA public key before install

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: embedded in app bundle: `app/scripts/public-key.pem` and `public-key-new.pem` (two allowed keys, first-match verification)
